paragraphs: Zone & Co’s goal to embed AI directly into Oracle NetSuite aligns with my experience deploying agent solutions in cloud environments, ensuring secure, automated workflows.
I deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda (Lambda Web Adapter) with ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.
I have not used Azure yet, but I am eager to learn it.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how my cloud‑native agent deployments could support your NetSuite AI platform?
